messages.subject: 0.9.1 isn't plotting anything
parts:
Hi all,

I must be missing something very obvious here -- I'm trying to update
plots I created a few months back, and ggplot2 is plotting a blank
coordinate system for all of them. I get this ...

http://icir.org/christian/tmp/wtf.png

... when running the following:

$ R --no-init-file
> require(ggplot2)
Loading required package: ggplot2
> d <- data.frame(x=1:10, y=1:10)
> ggplot(d) + geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y))

What am I missing? Where did my dots go?

Thanks,
-C.
